what: Post-commit residue check still treats allowed carryover as failure
scenario_or_breakage: A pre-existing dirty other.txt is skipped by the proposed guard and left uncommitted, but git status remains dirty after the coder commit, so the follow-up path fails or the final residue check returns CODER_STATUS=failed
suggested_fix: Apply the same carryover exclusion to the post-commit residue check and only run or fail follow-up for non-carryover tracked dirt; add an end-to-end orchestrator regression

what: Pre-staged carryover can be committed accidentally
scenario_or_breakage: If other.txt was already staged before coder dispatch, the proposed guard skips it as carryover, stage_round_dirty_paths adds only manifest paths, then git-commit.sh with no path args commits all staged changes including other.txt
suggested_fix: Constrain the round commit to manifest paths, for example git-commit.sh --only --pathspec-from-file "$stage_manifest", and add a staged-carryover regression
